Pinned copies of files from the urbit/urbit repository (https://github.com/urbit/urbit).

Upstream commit: 50c7f5239610fc72263df7aa99b4d171cfe9d408
Copied from:     /root/src/urbit (git -C /root/src/urbit rev-parse HEAD)

Each file keeps its upstream path under pkg/: vendor/base-dev/mar/txt.hoon is
pkg/base-dev/mar/txt.hoon, vendor/landscape/mar/docket-0.hoon is
pkg/landscape/mar/docket-0.hoon. tools/ship copies everything under
vendor/<package>/ into each desk it assembles, at the path below the package:
vendor/base-dev/mar/txt.hoon becomes /mar/txt/hoon. This file is not copied.

Files are unmodified. To update, copy them again from a newer commit and update
the commit and the hashes here. To check the copies against the hashes below:

    cd vendor && grep -E '^[0-9a-f]{64}  ' SOURCES.txt | sha256sum -c

Why each file is here:
- base-dev/mar/txt.hoon, txt-diff.hoon: %txt, which %jibb diffs and merges through (grad %txt), and its diff mark
- base-dev/mar/js.hoon, bill.hoon, kelvin.hoon: marks the doc lists for every app desk (desk.bill, sys.kelvin)
- base-dev/mar/hoon.hoon, mime.hoon, noun.hoon: marks Clay needs for .hoon files, Unix commits and the grad of %bill, %kelvin and %docket-0
- base-dev/lib/test.hoon: expect-eq and friends, for the -test thread's test files
- landscape/mar/docket-0.hoon: docket's mark, for desk.docket-0
- landscape/lib/docket.hoon, landscape/sur/docket.hoon: imported by docket-0.hoon (/+  dock=docket) and docket.hoon (/-  *docket)
